description:
With Adobe CX Enterprise Coworker, marketers and business practitioners can use natural language to access insights, analyze customer experiences, and complete marketing tasks across Adobe CX Enterprise. Coworker helps marketers expedite and automate workflows, accelerate decision-making, and turn ideas into action without requiring deep product expertise. Built with enterprise governance and context, it delivers trusted assistance at scale.

Language Support: AI Assistant is currently supported in English only. Non-English inputs may produce inconsistent or erroneous results.

Personal Data: If you include personal data in your prompts, only add what's necessary and only if you have the right to use it.

defaultPrompt: show top five loyalty audiences by profile size
create a loyalty campaign to re-engage abandoned cart customers
show me trend of conversion metric orders and identify drop in conversion in the last month
